title: Moving & Relocation Longest Quiet Streak
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=box:inventory
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day last(events) as prev_events
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where isnotnull(prev_day) AND prev_events>0 AND events=0 AND gap_days>=2
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_quiet_streak_days
description: Finds the longest multi-day gap with zero moving events after activity was previously present.
value: Quiet streaks often mean a broken export, a forgotten subscription, or a habit that silently died — all worth catching early.
implementation: Run daily on `box:inventory` after ingestion; investigate streaks that exceed your normal pause window for this domain.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest quiet streak with supporting timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the longest stretch with no moving activity at all so you can tell when a feed or habit went quiet for too long.
